title: Horten flying wing aircraft on the ground (Fig. 1)
description: Photograph of a Horten tailless flying wing aircraft parked outdoors in front of a building, viewed from a low angle along the wing. Text above describes the Junkers EF 130, ME 329 and Horten Wing designs, stating the Horten Wing bears "the closest resemblance to the estimated configuration of 'Flying Disks'". Captioned "Fig. 1".
